posthoc_training_negative_boundary_tensi.original_public_hypothesis: Receiving Party shall destroy or return some Confidential Information upon the termination of Agreement.

original_588_source_clauses.26: If either party decides that it does not wish to proceed with a transaction, it will promptly inform the other party of that decision.
original_588_source_clauses.27: In that case, or any time upon the request of a party for any reason, Vector will promptly, at Vector’s option
original_588_source_clauses.29: (ii) destroy all Evaluation Material (and all tangible copies thereof) furnished to it or its Representatives by or on behalf of the other party pursuant hereto, and in either case no copies thereof shall be retained except that, any of the foregoing notwithstanding, that portion of the Evaluation Material that may be found in analyses, compilations, studies, or other documents prepared by Vector’s Representatives, such Representatives’ agents, attorneys or employees, and oral or electronic Evaluation Material will be held by such Representatives and kept subject to the terms of this agreement or destroyed to the extent practicable and permitted by law.

previous_M2_guidance.when: A return-or-destruction duty is expressly and operatively linked to termination, expiration, rejection, or conclusion of the agreement or contemplated relationship.
previous_M2_guidance.inspection: Trace the grammar or cross-reference connecting the event to the duty. Do not infer a termination trigger merely because the document separately contains a term clause, continuing obligations, a decision not to proceed, or a request-triggered return remedy.
previous_M2_guidance.evidence_requirement: Cite the triggering event and the linked return-or-destruction command, plus language needed to identify the covered Confidential Information.

actual_new_M3_guidance.when: A return-or-destruction duty is expressly linked to termination, expiration, rejection, a decision not to proceed, or conclusion of the agreement, evaluation, negotiations, or contemplated relationship.
actual_new_M3_guidance.inspection: Trace each trigger through the complete sentence, including disjunctive triggers. A request-only remedy, a separate term clause, survival language, or a return section heading does not establish the required event; conversely, do not overlook a conclusion or no-transaction trigger merely because the same command also permits a request trigger.
actual_new_M3_guidance.evidence_requirement: Cite the qualifying event and the return-or-destruction command linked to it, together with language identifying the covered Confidential Information.

posthoc_training_negative_boundary_tensi.interpretation: The revised sufficient condition explicitly adds decision-not-to-proceed while a supplied original-NM witness has a linked decision-not-to-proceed return regime. This is an observable boundary tension requiring careful interpretation, not proof of independent legal truth or individual-skill causal harm.
